Congratulations, Ridhaan Tholampalayam Jayaraj (Cumberland Valley 9th Grade Academy) for winning the 2025 Congressional App Challenge for PA-10! 

I was honored to meet Ridhaan and learn more about his award-winning app, SnapScribe, and his future plans. 

SnapScribe allows for image resizing, color pallet extraction from images, splitting images, and using AI to pull text from images. It’s designed to make working with images faster and smarter, and helps users resize images without losing quality, extract text, analyze colors, and split images effortlessly.

Congratulations again, Ridhaan, on a job really well done. We look forward to seeing more of your future adventures and successes!
